<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/notification_rules/{rule_id}/re-enable"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Clear a Rule from the engine's auto-disabled set so it evaluates again.

Per-rule fault isolation auto-disables a Rule that raises during
evaluation (Requirement 14.2).  That set lives in the engine's memory, not
in ``notifications.json`` — so without this route the only way back is a
Grid restart, and a Rule knocked out by a transient fault stays silent
while still reading ``enabled`` in the UI.

Marks the engine dirty so the reload picks the Rule up on the next tick
rather than at the next restart.

Requirements: 14.2, 14.10
